text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock D at a loss and later buying it back higher reminds me to make each trade depend on current evidence, not on frustration or an urge to reverse course.","Selling Stock B below my average cost and buying it back may reflect poorly planned entry and exit decisions; I should set a clear reason and risk limit before trading.","A few months of account gains and losses are not enough to judge my skill, so I should track long-run, portfolio-wide returns and avoid overreacting to short-term moves."]}
